# Copilot usage notes for this repo

- **Stack & goals**: Astro 5 SSG blog with Tailwind CSS 4 (via Vite plugin), Pagefind static search, dynamic OG images (satori/resvg), and Umami analytics. Primary content is cybersecurity/how-to articles.
- **Content model** (`src/content.config.ts`): Blog posts live in `src/data/blog/**`. Frontmatter schema requires `title`, `description`, `pubDatetime`; optional `modDatetime`, `tags` (default `others`), `ogImage`, `canonicalURL`, `draft`, `featured`, `hideEditPost`, `timezone`. `author` defaults to `SITE.author`. Posts in `_`-prefixed folders are skipped.
- **Publishing rules**: Drafts are excluded. Non-draft posts only appear after `pubDatetime` minus `SITE.scheduledPostMargin` (15 minutes) unless `import.meta.env.DEV`. Keep `pubDatetime` realistic for scheduling.
- **Routing**: `getPath` derives URLs from nested folders under `src/data/blog`, slugifying segments; final path served under `/posts/...`. Index pagination is in `src/pages/posts/[...page].astro` (page size `SITE.postPerPage`). Individual posts render through `src/pages/posts/[...slug]/index.astro` with `PostDetails.astro` layout.
- **Layouts & components**: `Layout.astro` wraps pages with SEO props; `PostDetails.astro` handles prev/next links, edit button, tags, scroll progress bar, heading anchors, and copy-to-clipboard on code blocks. Shared UI lives in `src/components` (Card, Pagination, Tag, etc.) and `src/layouts/Main.astro` for standard page shells.
- **SEO & OG**: Default site metadata in `src/config.ts` (`SITE`), including `dynamicOgImage` toggle. Site-wide OG image served from `src/pages/og.png.ts`. Per-post OGs are generated at `/posts/.../index.png` when `dynamicOgImage` is true and no `ogImage` is provided. Set `editPost.url` there to keep the "Edit page" link correct.
- **Search**: Pagefind UI is wired in `src/pages/search.astro`. In dev, search results require at least one full `pnpm run build` to populate `dist/pagefind`; build copies the bundle to `public/pagefind` for static hosting.
- **Styles**: Tailwind 4 (no config file) plus `src/styles/global.css` and `typography.css`. Shiki transformers add filename badges and diff/highlight markers; keep code fences clean to preserve highlighting. Direction (`SITE.dir`) and light/dark toggle are respected across components.
- **Utilities**: Sorting/filtering helpers in `src/utils` (`getSortedPosts`, `postFilter`, `getPostsByTag`, `slugify`, `generateOgImages`, `loadGoogleFont`, etc.). Use provided helpers instead of reimplementing slug logic.
- **Env & analytics**: Public env schema declared in `astro.config.ts` for `PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION`, `PUBLIC_UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID`, `PUBLIC_UMAMI_URL`. Umami integration configured there; tracker served from `public/script.js`/`umami.guetta.tech`.
- **Scripts & workflows** (pnpm): `pnpm run dev`, `pnpm run build` (runs `astro check`, build, Pagefind, copies bundle), `pnpm run preview`, `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run format[:check]`. TypeScript paths use `@/*` (see `tsconfig.json`).
- **Content authoring tips**: Use descriptive `description` for SEO/snippets. Tag strings are slugified automatically; prefer concise tags. To hide edit link per post, set `hideEditPost: true`. Keep headings (`h2+`) present to enable auto-linked anchors and scroll progress.
- **Deployment expectations**: Designed for GitHub Pages/static hosting; `public/` holds static assets plus generated Pagefind bundle. Avoid server-only APIs.

If any section feels light or you need more concrete examples, tell me which area to expand (e.g., writing new utilities, theming, or adding data-driven pages).
